For player_count, we need minimum player count >5. So we can pass 6. So board_game_search({complexity: 2.5, player_count: 6}). That will return results.

Then trivia_game_search(duration: 60). That returns results.

We need to call both functions. Then output the results. The user likely wants the names of games. The function returns any. We need to format nicely.
